name: soul-sand-web-item
comment: WP-1.6g. Stone platform at y = 60 with the one-high rim of entity/flat-item-drop. Item 0 (cobblestone) drops from (0.5, 63.5, 0.5) with zero motion into a web at (0, 61, 0): BlockWeb has no collision box and sets isInWeb (BlockWeb.java:10-20), so it sinks 0.05 of its motion a tick (Entity.java:303-311). Item 1 drops from (3.5, 63.5, 0.5) moving +x onto soul sand at (3..4, 60, 0): it rests at the lowered top 60.875 and its horizontal motion is multiplied by 0.4 each tick it touches the block (BlockSoulSand.java:8-16). Item 2 starts above stone at (-6.5, 61.5, 3.5) moving +x at 0.3 and slides onto the soul sand strip (-6..-1, 60, 3).
